metadata.description: Open build standards for back-office workflows

plugins.name: build-standards
plugins.description: Open build standards for 22 back-office workflows: Database Reactivation, Dispatch Board, Inbox Triage, Follow Up, Two Records, Timesheet Check, Material Order, Recurring Report, Debtor Chasing, Booked After Hours, Quote Out, Rent Arrears, Fire Service Pack, Advice File, Multi Site Conformance, Cited Answer, Compliance Calendar, Invoice Out, Invoice Check, Rejected Pack, Knowledge Base, Knowledge Graph. Each carries ordered checks, object schemas, a conformance checklist and a pass test.
